caveats.message: Advisory diagnostic: reported beside the ladder verdict, never read by a gate, a threshold or a pre-registration.

data.method: The binding re-run through the engine (validation/engine_evaluator.py) with N bars more and N bars less history: N earlier bars prepended when they exist (extended), otherwise a second run starting cold N bars later (late start). Signals, indicator columns and trades are compared over the shorter run after its own declared warm-up; a change there means a recursive indicator has not converged by the declared warm-up (Freqtrade recursive-analysis).
